# CORE-QA-02

**Are the qualities that matter covered, and is each omission deliberate?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Core architecture lens](core.md) 0.6.0 |
| Area | QA: Quality attributes |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool checks presence; a reviewer judges |
| Reads | `scenarios.quality_attribute` |

## Why it matters

Reliability, security, performance, operability and cost are judged on every workload by the Well-Architected frameworks; a design silent on one is incomplete.

## Rule

Report each of reliability, security, performance-efficiency, maintainability, interaction-capability, safety and cost that no scenario covers, unless the design states the omission is deliberate. A quality, failure or misuse scenario counts for the quality_attribute it names.

## Sources

- ISO/IEC 25010:2023, Product quality model (`iso25010`)
- AWS Well-Architected Framework (`wa-aws`)
- Azure Well-Architected Framework (`wa-azure`)
- Google Cloud Well-Architected Framework (`wa-google`)
